source: SCNU 360 VR tour (.cache/vr cube faces) and the NGII 2025 orthophoto sheet 34702020 (0.25 m, 4x chips)
note: Bay symbols, keyed by a blue bay piece id (stages/markingsRegular.mjs emitBaySymbols). symbol: wheelchair (default), P (a parking or PM bay painted with a white P; a wheelchair template read from its painted figure gives way) or none; upBearingDeg: the direction the symbol's top points (degrees from north, clockwise; snapped to the bay axis nearest it), read where the bay's open end (aisle) and back (kerb, planting, building) show on the NGII 4x chip or the VR view; cells: the number of bays side by side when the piece's size misleads the row rule. Without upBearingDeg the back is the end that meets a kerb, sidewalk or building, else 추정. aisle: the hatched access aisle (보행안전통로) of a disabled bay, {bearingDeg: the side of the cell it lies on (snapped to the cell axis nearest it), widthM (read on the 4x chip, 추정), outside: true where it lies beyond the blue cell}, or one per cell. figure: a second painted figure that shares the bay with its symbol ({symbol: scooter, endBearingDeg: the end of the bay it lies at, frontBearingDeg: the way its front points}); the bay's symbol takes the other half.
